summary: WaFd, Inc. (Nasdaq: WAFD) disclosed a definitive Agreement and Plan of Merger, signed September 6, 2026, under which EverBank Financial Corp will merge into WaFd, with WaFd surviving and renaming itself EverBank Financial Corp; WaFd Bank will then merge into EverBank, N.A. Consideration is stock, with EverBank holders (including equity awards) receiving WaFd shares equal to an exchange ratio set so they own approximately 59.175% of the fully diluted post-close company. Both boards unanimously approved. No price per share, premium, or expected close date was stated. Watch regulatory approvals and exchange-ratio mechanics given EverBank holders gain control.
